moves.name: Tera Starstorm
moves.description: Replaces the effects of the user’s moves with the following when it is in Stellar Form. This move’s type becomes Stellar type. This attack’s power becomes double that of when the user is in Normal Form or Terastal Form. The target becomes all opposing sync pairs.

moves.name: Potion
moves.description: Restores an ally’s HP by approximately 40% of its maximum HP.

moves.name: Kaleidoscopic Tera Starstorm
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user uses any move once.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. Lowers the target’s Normal Type Rebuff by 3 ranks. Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 3. Replaces the effects of the user’s moves with the following when it is in Stellar Form. This move’s type becomes Stellar type. This attack’s power becomes double that of when the user is in Normal Form or Terastal Form. The target becomes all opposing sync pairs. Never misses. Lowers the target’s Stellar Type Rebuff by 3 ranks.

moves.name: Stellar Shine!
moves.description: Increases the user’s Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 3 ranks. Increases the user’s Sync Move ↑ Next effect by 5 ranks. Applies the Enduring effect to the user. If the user is in Stellar Form, also grants all of the following effects: Increases the user’s Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 2 ranks. Increases the user’s Sync Move ↑ Next effect by 5 ranks.

passives.name: Paldea’s Grand Mystery
passives.description: Powers up the moves and sync moves of all allied sync pairs by 20%. Reduces attack move and sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 25%. The more allied sync pairs with the Paldea theme you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by 15% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 50%, and the maximum damage reduction is 31%.) Reduces damage when the user is hit by an attack move or sync move when its HP is full.

passives.name: Prepare for Battle
passives.description: The user changes to Terastal Form the first time it enters a battle each battle.

passives.name: Debut: Sync CD ↓ & Sp. Atk ↑6
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1 the first time it enters a battle each battle. Raises the user’s Sp. Atk by 6 stat rank the first time it enters a battle each battle.

passives.name: Terastal Shell
passives.description: Reduces the MP for the user’s Potion by one and grants all of the following effects when its HP drops to half or below: Restores the user’s HP by approximately 60% of its maximum HP. Increases the user’s Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 3 ranks.

teraPassives.name: Shine Back to Zero
teraPassives.description: Removes all weather conditions and terrains the first time the user enters a battle each battle.

teraPassives.name: Debut: Sync CD ↓3 & Normal Zone
teraPassives.description: Reduces the users sync move countdown by three the first time it enters a battle each battle. Turns the field of plays zone into a Normal Zone the first time the user enters a battle each battle.

passives.name: 1st S-Move: Stellar S-Tera
passives.description: The user Sync Terastallizes into Stellar type the first time its sync move is used each battle.

passives.name: Terastal Energy Amplified
passives.description: Reduces the user sync move countdown by two when the user changes into Terastal Form. Raises the user critical-hit rate by three stat ranks when the user changes into Terastal Form.

cells.title: The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero’s Light
cells.description: Turns the field of play’s zone into a Normal Zone the first time the user enters a battle each battle. Turns the field of play’s zone into a Normal Zone the first time the user’s Rainbow Jewel Tera Blast is successful each battle. (A Normal Zone powers up Normal-type attacks.) Extends the duration of the Normal Zone when the zone turns into a Normal Zone while the user is on the field.

subPassives.name: Debut: Normal Zone
subPassives.description: Turns the field of play’s zone into a Normal Zone the first time the user enters a battle each battle. (A Normal Zone powers up Normal-type attacks.)

subPassives.name: 1st “Rainbow Jewel Tera Blast”: Normal Zone

subPassives.name: Normal Zone Extension 3
